name: InlineEdit
whenToUse: Renaming one value where it’s shown: a site name, a page title, a note.
Values people change now and then, not every time they visit.

whenNotToUse.text: Values that need confirmation or have consequences (a domain, an email)
Something people edit all the time

anatomy.description: the value as text, in the exact place and size the field will take.
small buttons next to the field.
from `validate` or a rejected `onSave`; the field stays open.

do.caption: One value, edited where it’s read.

dont.caption: A set of fields each saving on its own is a form in disguise — people won’t know what’s saved.

a11y: The display is a button named “Edit {label}”; `label` is required.
Enter saves (⌘/Ctrl+Enter in multiline), Escape cancels; focus returns to the text afterwards.
A failed save keeps what was typed and shows why.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the value, e.g. "Site name". Used for the field and the "Edit …" hint.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Passed to the input while editing (e.g. "off", "email").

props.name: inheritFont
props.description: Take the surrounding typography (e.g. inside an <h1>) instead of the field's own type step. Single-line only.

props.name: multiline
props.description: Multi-line text: TextArea while editing, line breaks kept on display. Enter adds a line, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter saves.

props.name: onSave
placeholder
props.description: Shown in place of an empty value.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Not editable: plain text, no hover, no edit hint.

props.name: saveOnBlur
props.description: Save when focus leaves the field. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Text step for the default and multiline treatments. Ignored with `inheritFont`.

props.name: validate
props.description: Return an error message to block saving, or undefined when the value is fine.
